prompt:
Subject: A sample of metallic molybdenum.

Composition: Show a single silvery-gray molybdenum metal piece with a freshly cut lustrous face resting in a shallow laboratory dish. A small element tile beside it bears only Mo and 42, identifying the otherwise visually similar metal without a spelled-out headword.

Style: Use the attached invidious.png for drawing style only. Match its thick rounded dark-brown contours, simplified rounded shapes, and restrained 2D cartoon shading. Do not copy the reference subject or composition.

Framing: One compact composition, with the complete subject using about 80-90% of the square. Keep everything inside the frame.

Output: 512x512 PNG, RGBA, genuine transparent background. Allow only the chemical symbol Mo and atomic number 42 on the element tile. No incidental labels, logos or watermark.
For each human: exactly two naturally attached arms and two hands.
en: The molybdenum sample has a shiny cut face beside its Mo element tile.
